hook: Before you plan next year's content, audit this year's message first.
direction: Angle: a quick self-audit before 2027 planning locks in. Cover: three checkpoints — does your homepage say who you help and how, does your social bio match your current mission, does your call to action tell people exactly what to do next. Frame as a checklist anyone can run in an hour. Graphic: tip card with a numbered checklist, three items, clean layout.

facebook.text:
Before you plan next year's content, audit this year's message first.

Before 2027 planning locks in, run this quick check on what you already have:

1) Does your homepage say clearly who you help and how?
2) Does your social bio still match your current mission?
3) Does your call to action tell people exactly what to do next?

That's it. One hour, three checkpoints. Most organizations find at least one of these is out of date before they ever open a planning doc. Fix the foundation before you build on it.
